scope: Six hosted controller profiles; three compiler profiles of actual serial/parallel/late AP startup, two regenerated low-page layouts, sparse 1/2/4 CPUs and changed CPU model.
limits: QEMU TCG evidence is not physical INIT/SIPI timing, arbitrary CPU compatibility or current errata review.
One-SIPI teaching policy, no retry on failed startup; Intel typical two-SIPI sequence is a separately identified difference.
Controller quiescence requires a trusted port premise; actual guest proves its specific permanent-stack handoff, not arbitrary caller attestations.
Bounded histories and finite machine matrix do not prove all executions, independent assessment or learner mastery.
